Below is the FAQ content to load.

What is Harbor Quill?
My public mission behind Harbor Quill is to support my household’s recovery after a fraudulent property investment collapsed. The launch uses my memoir novella as an unlimited-mint NFT ebook on Base and applies my first-of-its-kind CORA (Community Outreach Response Automation).
Readers who share it can immediately earn commissions and prizes without a set limit. If the model succeeds, it will grow into ArchiveLedger, a community-owned platform serving every independent creator.

How do buyers earn money?
1. Receive a $10 instant commission whenever somebody mints with your referral code
2. Get Small & Big Block prize tickets each time a mint uses your code
3. Qualify in the future for an ArchiveLedger governance token distributed to buyers, affiliates, and tippers

How do referrals work?
The permanent referral code for each NFT is its token serial.
Either of these methods works:
→ Share the complete link
→ Simply tell someone to “use referral 423”
A mint made with your code immediately gives you $10 plus Small & Big Block prize tickets for the active blocks.

Where do I find my referral code?
Use your token serial. It appears:
- In the on-chain metadata for your NFT
- On your Dashboard after minting
- Optionally, in your confirmation email

### What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
After roughly ~2,400 sales from mints and secondary transactions, Small Block draws 8 × $900.
After approximately ~180,000 sales from those same sources, Big Block draws 9 × $6,000.
Every sale continues funding the pools forever.

### How are winners selected?
Selection uses Chainlink VRF, making the process fully on-chain, provably fair, and verifiable on Basescan.

### What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
They are one-time entries for the active Small Block and Big Block draws. A successful referral earns 4 Small + 3 Big tickets.
Tickets expire after their block is drawn; referrals made afterward count toward the following blocks.

### How do I claim my rewards?
- $10 commissions → transferred automatically to your wallet
- Prize wins → published on the Winners page and claimable with one click at <http://harborquill.example|https://harborquill.example/>

### What are badges?
Your NFT receives on-chain badges at referral milestones of 5, 25, 125, 500+.
For now, they are cosmetic and provide leaderboard flex. Later, they may enable token-gated chats, discounts, airdrops, DAO weight, and similar benefits.

### Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes. Transak accepts cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, so minting requires neither cryptocurrency nor a wallet.

### Do I need a wallet to participate?
Only if you want affiliate commissions paid out or to trade the NFT later.

### What blockchain is this on?
It runs on Base (Ethereum Layer 2), which is fast, inexpensive, and Coinbase-backed.

### Are there any hidden fees?
No. A mint costs exactly $30, while secondary sales include a clearly shown $48 flat royalty.

### What happens if I sell my NFT?
The buyer receives the book, your original token serial as their referral code, and all badges you earned. Expired prize tickets remain expired.

### How do I share my referral link/code?
From the Dashboard, copy either the full link or your token serial and tell people to “use referral 423”.

### Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. It is single-level only, has unlimited supply, and its full source is verified on Basescan. I receive exactly $8 from every mint and secondary sale forever.

### How do I contact support?
Discord will not launch until there is real traction.
Until then, send a DM to @HarborQuill on X or email elias@harborquill.example. I respond personally and quickly.

For any remaining questions, DM @HarborQuill on X or write to elias@harborquill.example; I’m happy to help.

Once this content is loaded, the work is complete. The site will be surgically clean and difficult to misunderstand, so launch whenever you are ready—I’ll be available as soon as it goes live.

We also need a new FAQ section explaining how fiat buyers who are unfamiliar with crypto receive commissions and prizes. This is important for mainstream users because a non-custodial wallet is created behind the scenes, with the seed phrase not required, but they may not understand how to reach their rewards.

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?"

The flow should reassure customers paying by fiat, such as bank transfer, Apple Pay, etc., that everything is straightforward. When the book is minted for $30 through Transak, the buyer automatically receives a non-custodial wallet behind the scenes, with the seed phrase not required. That wallet stores the buyer's NFT and receives all commissions and prizes.

Earning Commissions ($10 per Referral):
The buyer shares a referral code, for example, "use 8421." Whenever another person mints with that code, $10 is sent automatically to the wallet address.
Collection requires no separate action. The buyer signs into <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> using a one-time email code or SIWE with the wallet Transak created, and the commissions appear immediately. If necessary, we can explain how to export the funds to a bank account or an exchange such as Coinbase.

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $900/$6,000 Draws):
Every referral automatically assigns tickets for the active prize draws and ties them to the buyer's NFT/wallet.
Fair on-chain randomness runs the draws at approximately ~750 sales for $900 and ~35,000 for $6,000.
Results are published on the Winners page and sent by email.

Prize collection is automatic as well: a winner receives either $900 or $6,000 directly in the wallet and should check the dashboard or email for the notification.

During the Purchase:
A fiat-to-crypto conversion is completed by Transak, which then mints the NFT directly into a newly created wallet address. Nothing has to be configured manually; the process is seamless and non-custodial. The buyer owns the keys without having to manage a complicated recovery phrase immediately.
An email confirmation then provides the mint number, which also serves as the referral code, along with NFT details and a dashboard link at <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example>.

For ebook access, could we use this setup?

Make Login-gated preview the standard experience. The email certificate would carry a large button reading "Read 'The Long Road Forward' Today," while download after verification would appear as a smaller "Save PDF for Later" link. The dashboard and email-linked reader should use PDF.js.

Does that work?

Please revise the landing page around the following structure and copy.

Hero Headline: Former apprentice entrepreneur bankrupted by a supplier collapse. Now starting over with an eBook model designed to free creators from Amazon's 45% cut.

Sub-Headline: "From Workshop Floor to Fresh Start" — Unlimited NFT book ⋅ $30 forever ⋅ Base.

Mechanics Tease: A purchase gives the buyer ownership of the book and a referral link. Each referral then pays an instant, unlimited $10 and supplies 4 entries to a $900 random giveaway every 750 sales.

CTA Button: Mint eBook NFT for $30

Across the page, make the frequency of the $900 prize the main motivator. For example, use language about recurring chances at $900 every 750 sales.

For the prize section, say: "Win $900 every 750 sales — one ticket per referral, with a fair Chainlink VRF draw. More referrals mean more chances."

The mechanics teaser should also include: "Refer for $10 and your opportunity to win $900 every 750 sales." Frame the experience as a continuing game for active promoters.

Please add these FAQs as well:

How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?
A buyer using fiat, including a credit card or Apple Pay, should be reassured that the process is simple even without crypto experience. Minting the book for $30 through Transak automatically creates a non-custodial wallet behind the scenes, without requiring a seed phrase initially. The wallet holds the NFT and receives commissions or prizes.

During the Purchase:
The fiat-to-crypto conversion is handled by Transak, which mints the NFT directly into a newly created wallet. No manual setup is necessary, and the process remains non-custodial: the buyer owns the keys without immediately managing a complicated seed phrase.
The confirmation email contains the mint number, which doubles as the referral code, along with NFT details and a dashboard link at <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example>.

Earning Commissions ($10 per Referral):
Buyers share their referral code, such as "use 8421." When another customer mints with it, $10 is transferred automatically to the wallet.
To view the funds, the buyer logs into <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> through the email link or SIWE using the wallet created by Transak. The commissions appear immediately without another action.

Earning and Winning Prizes:
Each referral automatically adds a ticket to the current prize draw and associates it with the relevant NFT and wallet.
Using fair on-chain randomness, the system runs a $900 draw every 750 sales. Winners appear on the Winners page and receive an email.
If a buyer wins, $900 goes directly to the wallet. Dashboard notifications should be accompanied by emailed, step-by-step guidance for viewing the funds or converting them to fiat, such as a link to a simple exchange guide. Access should not require a seed phrase.

How Do I Collect My Commissions and Prizes? (For Beginners)
Explain that tracking and payouts are automatic for newcomers.

Earning Commissions ($10 per Referral):
Whenever someone uses the buyer's mint-number referral code, found in the dashboard or confirmation email, the smart contract sends $10 directly to the wallet. No collection step is required.

Earning Prize Tickets:
Every successful referral also generates one ticket toward the $900 prize every 750 sales. Tickets are added to the NFT automatically, shown on the dashboard, recorded on-chain, and tied to the mint number.

Winning and Collecting Prizes:
Once a pool reaches its trigger every 750 sales, Chainlink VRF selects the winners through a fair random process. The Winners page and email both announce the result.
A winner receives $900 in the wallet immediately and gets both dashboard and email notifications.
Tickets apply only to their current draw; referrals made afterward create tickets for later blocks.

Other Wording Tweaks:
Keep the mechanics list focused on frequent $900 wins and the buyer's $10 commission, reinforcing the idea of cutting out intermediaries and directing the savings back to participants.

In the prize section, replace the existing explanation with a prominent skim-friendly headline: "$900 every 750 sales! 3 winners are randomly selected from that sales block using Chainlink VRF for provably fair randomness. More referrals mean more chances to win."

Elsewhere, refer to 3 affiliates and a 750 sales block, and make clear that every referral contributes to the draw. Another supporting callout can repeat that the $900 opportunity recurs every 750 sales.

General wording should replace "revolutionary" with "aligned" or "fair" to reduce hype and better reflect the ethos. Add the tagline "Help the rebuild — share to earn" below the statistics.

Visual/UI Tweaks:
Integrate the book cover into the hero alongside the headline.
Use "Mint your eBook" or "Mint your eBook NFT."
Add a live counter reading "Next $900 Draw In: ~X Sales" to create urgency around the next draw every 750 sales.
Finally, test the mobile layout so the statistics and mechanics stack cleanly without being cut off.

For consistency, the draw descriptions should use Chainlink VRF throughout, including the beginner explanation, the prize headline, and the detailed fairness copy.
